features.qr_body: Guests scan the QR on their table, browse your menu and order from their phone — no app to install. Orders land with the right table automatically.
features.kds_body: A live kitchen screen shows every ticket as it arrives, with status updates back to the floor, recipes and stock at hand.
features.waiter_body: Waiters take orders, answer table requests and collect bills; captains get a floor overview to assign tables and spot delayed orders.
features.booking_body: Accept advance table reservations and hall/event bookings with packages, decoration, cake and parking add-ons.
features.wallet_body: Customer wallets, loyalty points, coupons and promotions that bring guests back.
features.payments_body: Take UPI, card and net-banking payments online through Razorpay, alongside cash at the counter — with refunds tracked in one place.
features.branch_body: Run several locations from one account, each with its own tables, menu items, staff and QR codes.
features.inventory_body: Track stock and recipes, see which dishes are affected by low stock, and keep a customer list for repeat business.
features.analytics_body: Dashboards for sales, orders, payments and staff performance, with exports for your accountant.
features.kiosk_body: Put a tablet at the counter and let walk-in guests order and pay by themselves.
features.page_body: Every restaurant gets a shareable page with its menu, hours, takeaway and booking — at {{host}}.
features.lang_body: The customer app is available in English, Hindi and Marathi.
features.title: Everything your restaurant runs on
features.subtitle: From the guest’s first scan to the end-of-day report, every part of service stays in sync.

how.s1_body: Tell us your hotel name, city and pick your web address. Takes about two minutes.
how.s2_body: Our team reviews every signup — usually within one business day — and emails you when you’re live.
how.s3_body: Sign in to the admin panel, add your menu, tables and staff accounts.
how.s4_body: Download a QR code for each table, stick them up, and start taking orders.
how.title: Live in four steps

faq.q1: Do my guests need to install an app?
faq.a1: No. Guests scan the QR code on their table and order in their phone’s browser. Your staff use BestoDine in the browser too — on a phone, tablet or computer.
faq.a2: We review new registrations within about one business day. You’ll get an email as soon as your account is approved, and you can then sign in from the staff login page.
faq.a3: Plans that include a trial show the number of free days on their pricing card. If you’re unsure which plan fits, request a demo and we’ll help you choose.
faq.a4: Yes. BestoDine integrates with Razorpay for UPI, cards and net-banking, and your waiters can still settle cash bills at the table or counter.
faq.q5: I have more than one outlet. Is that supported?
faq.a5: Yes — plans with multi-branch support let you manage several locations from one account, each with its own tables, staff and QR codes.
faq.q6: What is my restaurant’s web address?
faq.a6: You choose it during registration, for example {{host}}. It becomes your public page with your menu, takeaway and booking options.
faq.title: Questions, answered
